stem: For promoted TVs, an analyst computes gross margin as (net revenue - COGS) / revenue at list price. What is wrong with this?

options.text: Promoted lines must be left out, since their margin is only temporary
The denominator must be net revenue, what customers actually paid
The denominator must be COGS, since margin is measured on cost
The numerator must use list revenue as well, so discounts drop out
